# Flatfile — Style Reference

> Graphite pencil on ledger paper, one sage sticky tab. FlatfileDiatype at one 400 weight sets everything on white canvas and #f8f8f8 panels, ruled by 1px #d7d7d7 hairlines, with pale sage #e5ebd3 as the only tint.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Flatfile speaks a gray-value ledger language: one grotesk at one weight does almost all the work, and hierarchy comes from how dark the ink is, not how heavy the stroke is. The canvas is #ffffff, with #f8f8f8 (37 background uses, the most frequent fill) as the tonal panel for cards and bands, #ededed as a small control well, and #151515 as the inverted footer. The chromatic budget is zero saturated system hues. The only tinted token is a pale sage #e5ebd3, rationed to one rebrand button. The lime-to-violet top strip and the teal-to-amber hero band are imagery, not tokens. FlatfileDiatype runs from 12px to 60px at weight 400 in 223 of 224 usages and tightens to roughly -0.03em at display sizes. Its size jumps sit near 1.6 rather than a Major Third. #808080 is the most-used text color (105 uses) and carries the second line of every large heading. Controls are 99px pills and panels are 0px squares, separated by tone and hairline rather than shadow. The result reads as an annotated spreadsheet rather than a marketing billboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page canvas, sticky nav fill, outline-button fill and inverted text on dark (16 bg + 8 text uses). It is the neutral sheet every gray value is measured against. |
| Fog Panel | `#f8f8f8` | `--color-fog-panel` | Resource cards, feature panels and section bands, with 37 uses as the most frequent background. It is a 3% tonal step that replaces shadow as the elevation mechanism. |
| Quartz Well | `#ededed` | `--color-quartz-well` | Active state of circular carousel buttons and small pressed wells. It is one step darker than Fog Panel, so selection reads as a tonal recess. Do not use it as a section background. |
| Linen Banner | `#f8f9f5` | `--color-linen-banner` | Base of the rebrand announcement band, under a soft green-white wash. The warm, faintly green neutral separates the corporate notice from the product page without adding a hue. |
| Carbon Footer | `#151515` | `--color-carbon-footer` | Full-bleed footer slab, the only inverted surface on the page. It closes the long white scroll with one dense block of near-black. |
| Ink | `#1b1b1e` | `--color-ink` | Headline first lines, body titles, the primary pill fill and secondary-button text (54 text + 3 fill uses). Text and action share one value, which makes it the workhorse dark. |
| Indigo Ink | `#090b2b` | `--color-indigo-ink` | Logo mark, card titles and icon-button glyphs (10 uses). This blue-black gives brand-owned marks a faint depth beside the neutral Ink. Do not use it for headlines. |
| Steel Caption | `#808080` | `--color-steel-caption` | Nav links, headline second lines, card descriptions and logo-wall tier labels, with 105 uses as the most-used text color. The secondary voice carries the hierarchy. |
| Pewter Meta | `#8c8c8c` | `--color-pewter-meta` | Metadata, dates and tertiary captions (39 uses). It sits one notch lighter than Steel Caption, so the third tier stays legible without a third font size. |
| Ash Footer | `#aaaaaa` | `--color-ash-footer` | Footer link text and captions on Carbon Footer (8 uses). It is the dark-surface counterpart of Steel Caption and keeps the footer from glaring. |
| Dove Border | `#d7d7d7` | `--color-dove-border` | 1px outline on secondary and Platform Login pills (6 uses). It is the firmer hairline that marks interactive edges. |
| Mist Hairline | `#e5e5e5` | `--color-mist-hairline` | 1px rules on circular icon buttons, logo-wall dividers and dropdown edges (9 uses). It is the quiet structural line that never competes with text. |
| Sage Signal | `#e5ebd3` | `--color-sage-signal` | Fill of the "Check out Obvious" banner button, used once. It is the system's only tint and works as a sticky tab rather than a brand color. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |

## Tokens — Typography

### FlatfileDiatype — the single-weight grotesk that sets every headline, label and paragraph · `--font-flatfile-diatype`

- **Substitute:** Inter Display at 400, Geist at 400, Instrument Sans at 400. Diatype Regular renders true to its nominal weight with a slightly open, even stroke. At 14px Inter draws marginally heavier, so keep 400 and do not drop to a lighter cut, which would read thinner than the original.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 16px, 22px, 38px, 60px
- **Line height:** 1.0 (38px, 60px), 1.18 (22px), 1.42 (12px), 1.43 (14px), 1.5 (16px)
- **Letter spacing:** -1.8px at 60px, -1.2px at 38px, -0.5px at 22px, -0.25px at 16px (headings and buttons), 0px at 16px (nav and UI), 0px at 14px, 0px at 12px
- **Role:** Weight 400 at 60px is the signature. Headlines are large and quiet, which runs against the SaaS convention of setting display type at 600 to 700. The scale is steep at the top: 22→38 is 1.73 and 38→60 is 1.58, roughly double the step of a Major Third 1.25. Size therefore announces a new section, and gray value ranks content within it. Tracking scales at about -0.03em on display sizes, so 60px setting tightens into a single dark bar with no extra weight. The variable cut (FlatfileDiatypeVariable) handles nav and UI text at 16px with normal tracking, and its one weight-500 instance is reserved for the rebrand button.

### Source Serif 4 — a serif interjection inside 38px headings · `--font-source-serif-4`

- **Substitute:** Source Serif 4 at 400 (open-source original), Newsreader at 400, Literata at 400. All three match the moderate contrast and draw no heavier than the measured cut.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 38px
- **Line height:** 1.0
- **Letter spacing:** -1.2px at 38px
- **Role:** It appears in 3 instances, at exactly the metrics of the Diatype heading: 38px, line-height 1.0, -1.2px. That makes it a voice change inside a sentence, not a second display face. The matched tracking lets a serif phrase sit on the same baseline rhythm as the grotesk. The serif is punctuation rather than decoration and should be limited to one phrase per heading.

### Sharp Grotesk — the rebrand banner's foreign headline face · `--font-sharp-grotesk`

- **Substitute:** Schibsted Grotesk at 500, Space Grotesk at 500. Sharp Grotesk Medium is wide and firm, so match it at 500 rather than 600.
- **Weights:** 500
- **Sizes:** 26px
- **Line height:** 1.42
- **Letter spacing:** -0.26px at 26px
- **Role:** It sets only the "Flatfile is now Obvious" headline in #0e1301, a banner-only ink that is not a system token. Its paragraph partner is Booton at weight 469, 16px, -0.08px, which is also not a system token. Together they quarantine the successor brand's voice inside one band. The weight 500 here is the deliberate exception that shows how weightless the Flatfile system is beneath it.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| caption | FlatfileDiatype | 400 | 12px | 1.42 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | FlatfileDiatype | 400 | 14px | 1.43 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | FlatfileDiatype | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | -0.25px | `--text-body` |
| subheading | FlatfileDiatype | 400 | 22px | 1.18 | -0.5px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading | Sharp Grotesk | 500 | 26px | 1.42 | -0.26px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | — | 400 | 38px | 1.0 | -1.2px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | FlatfileDiatype | 400 | 60px | 1.0 | -1.8px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every FlatfileDiatype heading from 22px to 60px at weight 400 — a constant stroke forces size and gray value to carry rank, which is the system's thesis.
- Split display headlines into two lines, #1b1b1e then #808080, at identical size — the gray line becomes a subordinate clause without changing weight.
- Track display type in proportion to size: -1.8px at 60px, -1.2px at 38px, -0.5px at 22px, -0.25px at 16px — tracking near -0.03em tightens headings into solid bars without adding weight.
- Round every button to 99px and keep cards, panels and images at 0px — the pill-control, square-panel pairing is non-negotiable and is how users tell actions from content.
- Layer surfaces by tone: #ffffff canvas, #f8f8f8 panels, #ededed wells, 1px #e5e5e5 hairlines — tonal steps of 3 to 7% replace the drop-shadow stack most SaaS sites use.
- Use #1b1b1e for both the headline ink and the primary pill fill — one dark value for words and actions keeps the CTA the darkest object without a brand hue.
- Build on the 4px grid, with 16px as the default gap and 120px between sections — 16px appears 133 times, and the large section gap gives the single weight room to read as calm.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 600 or 700 to make them land — that conventional move collapses the gray-value hierarchy and makes the #808080 second line read as an error rather than a clause.
- Don't add a saturated brand blue or purple for links and CTAs — the chromatic budget is zero, and a hue would immediately outrank the #1b1b1e pill.
- Don't promote sage #e5ebd3 to the main CTA or section backgrounds — it is rationed to the rebrand banner, and spreading it turns a sticky tab into a theme.
- Don't round cards or feature panels to the conventional 12–16px — 0px panels against 99px controls is the shape contrast, and soft cards blur it.
- Don't put drop shadows on cards or buttons — the six-layer `--shadow-lg` stack is never applied to a card and exists only for the floating file chips in the banner.
- Don't set 14px descriptions in #1b1b1e — supporting copy belongs to #808080, and dark description text flattens the two-tone pairing used from the mega-menu up to the h1.
- Don't carry Sharp Grotesk 500 or Booton 469 into product sections — they belong to the successor brand's banner, and mixing them in dilutes the single-family discipline.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- panel surface: #f8f8f8 (Fog Panel)
- primary text: #1b1b1e (Ink)
- secondary text: #808080 (Steel Caption)
- hairline: #e5e5e5 (Mist Hairline)
- control border: #d7d7d7 (Dove Border)
- inverted surface: #151515 (Carbon Footer)
- primary action: #1b1b1e (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars stay neutral, with primary series in solid #1b1b1e, secondary series in #808080 and gridlines in #e5e5e5. Sage #e5ebd3 may appear only as a full-opacity highlight band behind one selected row, so no data mark becomes louder than the ink CTA.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor styled as a pill with background #1b1b1e, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 99px, padding 12px 24px, height 48px, font-family FlatfileDiatype (fallback Inter Display) at 16px, weight 400, line-height 24px, letter-spacing -0.25px, and no shadow. On hover, swap the background to #151515. Pair it with a secondary pill: background #ffffff, text #1b1b1e, 1px solid #d7d7d7 border, the same 99px radius and 12px 24px padding, separated by a 16px gap.

2. Build a hero section on #ffffff with 120px top and bottom padding, content centered inside a 1168px container. The h1 is FlatfileDiatype at 60px, weight 400, line-height 60px, letter-spacing -1.8px, in two lines: "AI-powered" in #1b1b1e and "data migration" in #808080. Below it, with a 24px gap, place a paragraph at 16px/24px, weight 400, -0.25px, color #808080, max-width 650px. Then, after a 32px gap, place the 48px primary pill (#1b1b1e, #ffffff, radius 99px, padding 12px 24px). Use no shadow and no gradient on the text.

3. Build a Resource Card: a block 384px wide with background #f8f8f8, border-radius 0px, padding 24px, and no border or shadow. Inside, place a 336px × 231px image at 0px radius, then after a 16px gap a title in FlatfileDiatype at 16px, weight 400, line-height 24px, letter-spacing -0.25px, color #090b2b. Follow it with meta text at 14px/20px, weight 400, color #808080, with 4px top padding. Lay three cards in a row with 16px gaps.

4. Build a Navigation Bar: a sticky 72px-tall bar with background #ffffff and content inside a 1168px container. On the left, place a 31px × 29px logo mark in #090b2b, then links "Product, Solutions, Resources, Company, Pricing" in FlatfileDiatype at 16px, weight 400, color #808080, each with padding 24px 16px. On the right, place "Log in" at 16px #808080, a 1px #e5e5e5 vertical divider 20px tall, then a compact pill (background #1b1b1e, text #ffffff, 14px weight 400, padding 8px 16px, height 36px, radius 99px). The login dropdown is #ffffff with a 1px #e5e5e5 border, 8px radius and 16px padding.

**Role:** Learn-more links beside product sections

It is the default for every non-conversion link that deserves a button.

### Sage Banner Button (Rebrand Outlier)
**Role:** Exit ramp to the successor brand

The deliberate system outlier. It has background #e5ebd3, text #0e1301 (banner-only, not a system token), no border, border-radius 12px, padding 9px 14px, height 42px, FlatfileDiatypeVariable at 16px weight 500, and no shadow. It breaks three rules at once: the only tint, the only 12px radius on a control, and the only weight 500 in Diatype. That is allowed because it belongs to Obvious, the successor brand, and marks the banner as a separate document stapled above the page.

### Circular Icon Button
**Role:** Carousel previous and next controls

Small round stones. Each is 40px × 40px with border-radius 100px, a 1px solid #e5e5e5 border, padding 0px, and a glyph in #090b2b. The fill is #ededed for the active or pressed state and #ffffff at rest, with no shadow. State changes by tone alone, which keeps the system's elevation logic consistent down to the smallest control.

**Role:** Sticky product-wide wayfinding

A white ruled strip. It is sticky and 72px tall, with background #ffffff and content aligned to the 1168px container. The #090b2b logo mark (31px × 29px) sits left. Product, Solutions, Resources, Company and Pricing follow in FlatfileDiatypeVariable at 16px weight 400 in #808080, each with padding 24px 16px so the hit area fills the full bar height. "Log in" in #808080, a 1px #e5e5e5 divider (estimated) and the compact ink pill sit right. One nav element carries a 999px radius, which repeats the capsule logic. Gray links and a single dark pill turn the bar into an index line, not a toolbar.

### Utility Dropdown Panel
**Role:** Login routing and version notes

A small floating index card. It has background #ffffff, a 1px solid #e5e5e5 border (estimated), border-radius 8px and padding 16px (estimated). It holds the compact outline Platform Login pill and a 12px/1.42 caption in #808080 reading "Unsupported Versions: Flatfile v0.3". The 8px radius is the only soft corner on a container. **Role:** Product entries inside nav menus

Text-only list rows. Each column is 242px wide with padding 8px 0px and no background, border or radius. Workbooks, Mapping, Configuration, Collaboration, Security and Transform all use this two-tone pair. The menu repeats the headline thesis at micro scale: dark noun, gray explanation, same weight.

### Resource Card
**Role:** Guides and articles in menus and grids

A square fog tile. It has background #f8f8f8, border-radius 0px, padding 24px, no border, no shadow and a footprint of 384px × 364px. Inside, a 336px × 231px image sits at 0px radius above a title in FlatfileDiatype at 16px weight 400 with -0.25px tracking in #090b2b, then 14px meta in #808080 with 4px top padding. Card conventions call for 12 to 16px corners and a drop shadow. This card takes neither, which reads as a ledger cell rather than a floating tile.

### Feature Panel — Two-Up
**Role:** Product capability diagrams

Gray boards with line drawings. Two panels share the 1168px container (for example "Smart Extraction" and "Source File Types"), each with background #f8f8f8, border-radius 0px, padding 24px (estimated) and no shadow. Each carries a title in FlatfileDiatype at 16px weight 400 in #1b1b1e and a schematic diagram drawn in gray hairlines with one solid #1b1b1e bar. The illustration speaks the same monochrome as the UI, so the panel explains a mechanism without any hue.

**Role:** Customer proof segmented by segment

A ruled grid. A left label column holds h3 tier names (Public, Growth, Startup) in FlatfileDiatype at 16px weight 400 with -0.25px tracking in #808080. Eight logo tiles per row follow, separated by 1px #e5e5e5 hairlines, with monochrome logos and no tile fill or radius. ### Two-Tone Section Heading
**Role:** Every hero and section headline

The signature component. The h1 is FlatfileDiatype at 60px/1.0, weight 400, -1.8px, and the section h2 is 38px/1.0, weight 400, -1.2px. Line one is #1b1b1e and line two is #808080 at identical size and weight. Source Serif 4 at the same 38px metrics may replace one phrase. The gray second line does the job most systems give to a bold first line: it ranks clauses by value, not stroke.

### Footer
**Role:** Inverted sitemap that closes the page

A dark slab. It spans the full 1920px width with background #151515 and padding 64px 0px 0px. Text is FlatfileDiatype at 14px/1.43 weight 400, with column titles in #ffffff, links in #aaaaaa and 12px uppercase labels at 0px tracking. The footer is the only inverted surface and uses the same single weight. It ends the white scroll with a period, not a gradient.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every FlatfileDiatype heading from 22px to 60px at weight 400 — a constant stroke forces size and gray value to carry rank, which is the system's thesis.
- Split display headlines into two lines, #1b1b1e then #808080, at identical size — the gray line becomes a subordinate clause without changing weight.
- Track display type in proportion to size: -1.8px at 60px, -1.2px at 38px, -0.5px at 22px, -0.25px at 16px — tracking near -0.03em tightens headings into solid bars without adding weight.
- Round every button to 99px and keep cards, panels and images at 0px — the pill-control, square-panel pairing is non-negotiable and is how users tell actions from content.
- Layer surfaces by tone: #ffffff canvas, #f8f8f8 panels, #ededed wells, 1px #e5e5e5 hairlines — tonal steps of 3 to 7% replace the drop-shadow stack most SaaS sites use.
- Use #1b1b1e for both the headline ink and the primary pill fill — one dark value for words and actions keeps the CTA the darkest object without a brand hue.
- Build on the 4px grid, with 16px as the default gap and 120px between sections — 16px appears 133 times, and the large section gap gives the single weight room to read as calm.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 600 or 700 to make them land — that conventional move collapses the gray-value hierarchy and makes the #808080 second line read as an error rather than a clause.
- Don't add a saturated brand blue or purple for links and CTAs — the chromatic budget is zero, and a hue would immediately outrank the #1b1b1e pill.
- Don't promote sage #e5ebd3 to the main CTA or section backgrounds — it is rationed to the rebrand banner, and spreading it turns a sticky tab into a theme.
- Don't round cards or feature panels to the conventional 12–16px — 0px panels against 99px controls is the shape contrast, and soft cards blur it.
- Don't put drop shadows on cards or buttons — the six-layer `--shadow-lg` stack is never applied to a card and exists only for the floating file chips in the banner.
- Don't set 14px descriptions in #1b1b1e — supporting copy belongs to #808080, and dark description text flattens the two-tone pairing used from the mega-menu up to the h1.
- Don't carry Sharp Grotesk 500 or Booton 469 into product sections — they belong to the successor brand's banner, and mixing them in dilutes the single-family discipline.

## Elevation

- **Floating file chips in the rebrand banner (the only lifted objects):** `0px 20px 34px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.11), 0px 13px 21px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09), 0px 8px 13px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0px 5px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07), 0px 3px 4px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)`
- **Recessed scrolling wells and embedded previews:** `inset 0px 8px 12px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), inset 0px -8px 12px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)`

## Imagery

The page relies on product-truthful illustration rather than photography. Feature panels hold monochrome schematic diagrams in gray hairlines on #f8f8f8, framed at 0px radius with no border or shadow. The rebrand banner shows a fan of tilted file chips (.pptx, .json, .xls) with small colored file-type icons in orange and green. Those hues are decorative and not system tokens, and they are the only objects carrying `--shadow-lg`. A 4px lime-to-violet gradient runs along the very top edge, and a full-bleed blurred teal-to-amber band sits below the hero. Both are decorative backdrops, not tokens. Logos are rendered monochrome and icons are thin line glyphs in #090b2b. The narrative is messy files becoming orderly gray structure.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1168px container centered on a 1920px canvas, with section gaps of 120px that drop to 88px between related blocks. The hero is centered: the 60px two-tone h1, a short #808080 paragraph capped near 650px, and one 48px ink pill. A full-bleed gradient band follows. Sections then alternate between left-aligned proof (the 38px heading over an eight-column logo wall with a tier-label column) and centered feature heads over two-column #f8f8f8 panels. Resource grids use three 384px cards. The nav is sticky, filled #ffffff and 72px tall, with logo and five links on the left and Log in plus the compact pill on the right. The footer is a #151515 multi-column sitemap with 64px top padding. At 375px, drop the display to 38px and section gaps to 64px. Density: comfortable.

## Gray-Value Hierarchy

Flatfile ranks text by lightness, not weight. 223 of 224 Diatype usages sit at 400, and #808080 outnumbers #1b1b1e as a text color 105 to 54. Every tier, from the mega-menu description to the 60px headline, is a dark noun followed by a gray explanation. The discipline breaks the moment a designer adds weight 600 for emphasis, uses a third gray darker than #808080 for "important" captions, or colors a phrase to draw attention. To extend the system, add new emphasis as a split rather than a style: move the subordinate clause to #808080 at the same size, or drop it to #8c8c8c for a third tier. When a phrase needs a different voice, swap it to Source Serif 4 at matched metrics instead of bolding it.

## Pill Versus Square

The shape vocabulary has two words. Anything you press is a capsule at 99px, 100px or 999px. Anything you read is a square at 0px. The resource card, feature panels, images and sections all measure 0px, while all nine sampled Flatfile buttons are pills. The only exceptions are transient or foreign: the 8px dropdown and the 12px Obvious button. The system breaks if cards are softened to a conventional 12px, if buttons are squared to 4px to "match," or if a third radius such as 6px appears on tags. To extend it, give new interactive elements the 99px pill and new content containers 0px with a #f8f8f8 fill. Reserve 8px strictly for floating layers that dismiss.

## Rebrand Quarantine

The top band announcing "Flatfile is now Obvious" runs a separate system. It uses Sharp Grotesk 500 at 26px, Booton 469 at 16px, ink #0e1301, a green-white wash over #f8f9f5, a 12px-radius sage #e5ebd3 button and the page's only drop-shadowed objects. Every one of those values breaks a Flatfile rule, and the containment is what makes that acceptable: none of them leak below the band. The discipline breaks if the sage tint reaches section backgrounds, if Sharp Grotesk sets a product heading, or if the six-layer shadow spreads to cards. To extend the system, keep any future announcement, partner or successor-brand content in its own full-width band with its own type. Return to Diatype 400, #ffffff and hairlines at the band's lower edge.

## Similar Brands

- **Vercel** — An ink-black pill CTA on a white canvas with gray secondary text and hairline structure. Vercel's Geist headlines run at 600 where Flatfile holds 400.
- **Attio** — Two-tone headlines that drop the second clause to gray at the same size. Attio rounds its cards around 12px where Flatfile keeps panels at 0px.
- **Mercury** — Display type at weight 400 on a pale canvas, with a serif voice inserted at heading size. Mercury warms its neutrals where Flatfile stays on pure #808080 gray.
- **OneSchema** — A direct category competitor in CSV import and data onboarding with the same white canvas and dark pill CTAs. OneSchema spends a saturated purple accent where Flatfile's budget is zero.
